essence: She knows what it is to carry marks she did not choose, so she makes new ones. Every piece she inks is an act of overwriting — the needle saying your body is a canvas and I will make it holy.
clan: A CULTIC DRUID tribe, and she is named for the Morrígan. One of four Pleasures subflight survivors.
note: Her leather-bound ink list — date, design, recipient, and ONE WORD for the emotion present during the session — reads as a record of rites rather than a work log. The book is sacred and nobody touches it without permission.
